fields.help: Short unique key, used to reference this row from other sheets. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
fields.label: ID

fields.help: Display name of the objective.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: What achieving this objective means, in a sentence or two.
fields.label: Definition

fields.help: IDs of KPIs that measure progress. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Measured by KPIs

fields.help: ID of the role that owns this (ownership always sits with a role, not a person).
fields.label: Owner role

fields.help: enterprise, function, capability or process: where the objective sits in the cascade.
fields.label: Level

fields.help: ID of the objective this one contributes to, one level up. Empty for an enterprise objective.
fields.label: Parent objective

fields.help: When objectives pull against each other, the lower number wins: 1 is the highest priority. Compare objectives with the same parent.
fields.label: Priority

fields.help: IDs of other objectives that progress on this one helps. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Supports objectives

fields.help: IDs of objectives that progress on this one can set back (on-time payment against working capital). A conflict counts both ways. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Conflicts with objectives

help: Outcomes the organization intends to achieve, in a cascade from the enterprise down, with their owners, priorities and the objectives they pull against.
label: Objectives

fields.help: Short unique key, used to reference this row from other sheets. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
fields.label: ID

fields.help: Display name of the KPI.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: How the KPI is calculated, and what a good value looks like.
fields.label: Definition

fields.help: e.g. percent, days, USD
fields.label: Unit

fields.help: ID of the role that owns this (ownership always sits with a role, not a person).
fields.label: Owner role

fields.help: IDs of the data products the KPI is calculated from. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Computed from data products

fields.help: IDs of the capabilities whose health this KPI shows. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Health of capabilities

fields.help: The value past which the capability counts as degraded, in the KPI's unit.
fields.label: Health threshold

fields.help: higher: degraded below the threshold. lower: degraded above it.
fields.label: Better when

fields.help: The latest value, usually loaded from the metrics layer, in the KPI's unit.
fields.label: Current value

fields.help: When the current value was measured (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.label: Measured on

help: Measures of progress. Used to route impact to their owners, not as targets; with a health threshold, they also show whether a capability is degraded.
label: KPIs

fields.label: Owner role

fields.help: IDs of the objectives this capability contributes to. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Serves objectives

fields.help: ID of the broader capability this one is part of. Empty for a top-level capability.
fields.label: Parent capability

fields.help: IDs of the processes that carry out this capability. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Realized by processes

fields.help: IDs of the data products this capability creates and answers for. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Produces data products

fields.help: IDs of the data products this capability depends on. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Consumes data products

help: What the organization is able to do; the spine of the model.

fields.label: Jurisdiction

fields.help: ID of the role that owns this (ownership always sits with a role, not a person).
fields.label: Owner role

fields.help: IDs of authorities, actions, data products or systems this constrains.

fields.help: URL of the policy text.

fields.help: Short unique key, used to reference this row from other sheets. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
fields.label: ID

fields.help: Display name of the person.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: From HR; used to match the same person across systems.
fields.label: Employee ID

fields.help: Work email. Used to match the person to their sign-in.
fields.label: Email

fields.help: IDs of the roles the person holds today. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Roles filled

fields.help: ID of the person's manager.
fields.label: Reports to

fields.help: Department or supervisory organization code, from HR. Used for an authority's scope.
fields.label: Department

fields.help: Cost centre code, from HR or finance. Used for an authority's scope.
fields.label: Cost centre

help: Only role-relevant facts. Anything else is rejected by the validation rules.
label: People

fields.help: Short unique key, used to reference this row from other sheets. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
fields.label: ID

fields.help: Display name of the authority.
fields.label: Name

fields.help: ID of the role, person or agent that holds this authority.
fields.label: Holder

fields.help: IDs of the actions this authority lets the holder take. Separate several with ';'.
fields.label: Actions covered

fields.help: ID of the capability the authority is limited to. Empty: wherever its actions apply.
fields.label: Within capability

fields.help: The largest amount the holder may decide for one action, in the currency given. Empty: no amount limit.
fields.label: Limit amount

fields.help: ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD.
fields.label: Currency

fields.help: amount (money, the default), percent (e.g. a raise), grade-steps (a promotion) or headcount (hires).
fields.label: Limit kind

fields.help: For a limit kind other than amount: the largest value the holder may decide, e.g. 10 (percent).
fields.label: Limit value

fields.help: Over whom: any (default), reporting-line (people below the holder), department or cost-centre.
fields.label: Scope

fields.help: For department or cost-centre scope: the unit's code. Empty: the holder's own.
fields.label: Scope unit

fields.help: First day the authority holds (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty: from now.
fields.label: Valid from

fields.help: Last day the authority holds (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty: until withdrawn.
fields.label: Valid until

fields.help: Who granted it: a person, a role, or the policy that establishes it.
fields.label: Delegated by

fields.help: For narrower copies (e.g. an agent's authority): the authority this is a bounded subset of.
fields.label: Parent authority

help: Grants to decide or act, with their limits.
label: Authorities

fields.help: Optional; generated from the other fields when omitted.
fields.label: ID

fields.help: ID of the authority that requires this co-approval.
fields.label: Authority

fields.help: ID of the role whose sign-off is needed. Give this or an approver relation.
fields.label: Approver role

fields.help: Instead of a role: manager or manager-of-manager of the person the action is about, or principal-manager.
fields.label: Approver relation

fields.help: Order in an approval chain (1, 2, ...): the decision lists its sign-offs in this order. Empty: first.
fields.label: Step

fields.help: Applies above this amount (or, for another limit kind, this value). Empty: always.
fields.label: Above amount

help: Further sign-offs: a second sign-off above an amount, or the steps of an approval chain. One row per tier or step.
label: Co-approvals

fields.help: ID of the board or committee (as a role) that approved it, e.g. the AI review board.

fields.help: approved: may run. conditional: may run under the conditions given. suspended: must not run for now. retired: no longer in use.
fields.label: Status

fields.help: IDs of the agents this approval applies to. Separate several with ';'.

fields.help: Actions the approved use may take. Empty: the approval does not limit actions.
fields.label: Allows actions

fields.help: Date of the board's decision (YYYY-MM-DD).
fields.label: Approved on

fields.help: When the board must review the approval again.

fields.help: Conditions the board attached.
fields.label: Conditions

help: Governance board decisions: which AI uses may run, for which agents and actions. From the board's register or minutes.
label: AI use cases
